_comment: English strings. Keys are referenced from the code; do not hardcode interface text.
app.name: Nolde Launcher
app.tagline: Discover, install and play community game projects.
loading.catalog_offline: Catalog unavailable. Showing your installed games and the last saved catalog.
loading.catalog_offline_empty: Catalog unavailable and no saved copy exists. Your installed games are still available.
discover.search_placeholder: Search by game or project name
discover.empty: No projects match your search and filters.
discover.offline_banner: Showing a saved copy of the catalog from {when}.
discover.load_failed: The catalog could not be loaded: {reason}
availability.reason_no_repo: No supported GitHub repository is listed for this project.
availability.reason_no_release: The repository has no published releases.
availability.reason_rate_limited: GitHub's API rate limit was reached. Try again later.
availability.reason_not_found: The repository could not be accessed.
availability.gitlab_note: This project is hosted on GitLab. Builds from that source are not supported yet.
detail.original_files_yes: Yes. You must provide files from your own copy of the game. They are not included with this project.
detail.original_files_no: No original game files are required.
detail.original_files_unknown: The project does not state whether original game files are required.
detail.made_with_ai: The project states that it was made with AI assistance.
detail.checking: Looking for a verified Windows build…
install.confirm_body: This downloads the build from {source} and extracts it into your library folder. Nothing is run during installation. The game does not include the original game files: {original_note}
install.exists: A folder with this name already exists. Remove the existing installation first, or choose another library folder.
install.choose_exe_body: Several executables were found. Select the one that starts the game.
install.no_exe: No Windows executable was found in this build. The project may need manual setup. Its folder has been kept so you can inspect it.
install.hash_none: Integrity check: no trusted hash is published for this build.
library.empty: No installed projects yet. Install one from Discover.
library.uninstall_body: This deletes the launcher-managed folder for this project from your library. Your original game files and other folders are not touched.
library.first_run_body: This build was downloaded from a third-party project. Start it only if you trust the source. It runs with your normal user permissions.
settings.title: Settings
settings.catalog_status_none: No catalog has been loaded yet.
settings.updates: Launcher updates are checked from the release page you install from. Automatic self-update is not available in this version.
settings.locked_downloads: Changing the folder does not move existing downloads or installations.
library.title: Library
settings.show_details: Show description, badges and platform tags on cards
settings.appearance_hint: Text-only and small cards load and draw faster on modest computers.
settings.refresh_on_start: Refresh the catalog when the launcher starts
settings.performance_hint: Turning animations, hover effects or artwork off reduces CPU and memory use. Changes apply immediately.
settings.motion_full: Full — transitions, card effects and hover
settings.motion_hint: Reduced is the default on computers with four cores or fewer. Off uses the least processing.
settings.launcher_update_idle: Early Access {version}. Updates come from the GitHub releases page.
settings.updates_hint: A verified update package is downloaded and its SHA-256 checked. Installing it is manual for now.
settings.check_updates_on_start: Look for new versions of installed games when the launcher starts
settings.diagnostics_hint: Creates a text file with versions, settings and recent log lines. Your user name and home folder are removed.
library.no_updates: No updates found for your installed games.
library.no_catalog_entry: This game is no longer in the catalog.
library.update_unavailable: No verified update build is available right now.
library.update_body: Version {version} will be downloaded from the verified source. Files inside the game folder are replaced, so any save files kept there are replaced too. Play time and settings are kept.
settings.launcher_not_configured: No official update source is configured in this version.
settings.launcher_ready: Version {version} was downloaded and verified. Folder: {path}
settings.notifications: Show Windows notifications when installs finish or updates are found
integrity.create_body: This game was installed before integrity records existed. A record can be created now from the files as they are. It only detects changes made after this point. Create it now?
welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.heading: Welcome to {name}
welcome.body_early: You are using an Early Access version. Some games may not install or run yet, and things change quickly. Your feedback helps decide what comes next.
welcome.body_updates: New versions will keep arriving. The launcher checks for updates automatically, downloads them only after verifying their SHA-256, and asks before installing.
welcome.body_feedback: Found a problem or have an idea? Open an issue on the GitHub repository.
update.ready_body: Nolde Launcher {version} is downloaded and verified. Install it now? The launcher will close, upgrade, and start again.
update.later: Version {version} is ready. It will be offered again the next time you start the launcher.
settings.launcher_source_build: Version {version} is available on GitHub. Automatic installation works only in the packaged launcher.
settings.check_launcher_updates: Check for a newer launcher when it starts
settings.theme_hint: The primary colour sets the backgrounds. The secondary colour sets buttons and lines. Everything else is derived from these two.
custom.manual_hint: This app is managed by hand. Put its files in the app folder, then register the program to start it.
custom.steps_problems: {count} extra step(s) did not finish. See the log.
custom.uninstall_first: Uninstall the app before removing it from the list.
custom.remove_body: It will leave the launcher's list. Its files are not deleted.
custom.registered: {name} is registered. You can play it now.
custom.pick_program: Choose the program that starts this app
custom.display_placeholder: Leave empty to use the project name
custom.folder_placeholder: Leave empty to use the project name
custom.tags_placeholder: Comma separated, for example: mod, tool
custom.files_placeholder: One local file per line; copied into the game folder after install
custom.own_folder: Install each mod into its own folder
custom.name: Project name
custom.author: Author
custom.display_name: Custom name shown in the launcher
custom.mode_manual: Manual: no repository and no updates
custom.form_hint: Managed apps need a public GitHub repository and install its release. Manual apps have no download: you copy the files yourself.
